arguments.content:
"""URL slug generation."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re


def slugify(text: str, sep: str = "-") -> str:
    """Convert ``text`` into a lowercase URL slug.

    A run of non-alphanumeric characters is collapsed into a single
    separator, so the result never starts or ends with ``sep``.

    Args:
        text: Input text.
        sep: Separator character to use between words.

    Returns:
        The slugified string. An empty string is returned when ``text``
        contains no alphanumeric characters.

    Raises:
        ValueError: If ``sep`` is not exactly one character.
    """
    if len(sep) != 1:
        raise ValueError("sep must be a single character")

    words = re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", text.lower())
    return sep.join(words)
